description: Retain the selected governing source constraints for ordinary SDLC work and incremental QA, evidence-led causal triage and lawful owner re-entry, bounded repair verification and conditional rechecks, named boundary decisions, drift and valid evidence reuse. This is predecision method-workflow constraint coverage over the stated source closure, not proof of task admission, technical design correctness, repair success, performed/independent assessment or boundary acceptance. Technical specialist and Product-specific law remains an explicit task acquisition obligation. The selected guidance belongs to exact native STDO 3.1.0-rc.1; the caller binds its complete operative constitution and actual Product adoption. An index is not a partial constitution or an adoption decision. Exact source, purpose, index and query bind any external assessment.

facts.action: The actual requested workflow operation: work, qa, triage, repair, boundary, or reuse. The operation label creates no work grant or result.
facts.adopted_defaults: True only when the owning Product or admitted trial explicitly selected this exact default projection from the selected native cut. Installation, discovery, or a newer index is not selection. The complete operative constitution remains separately bound.
facts.boundary_kind: The actual decision boundary: none, landing, work_closure, product_acceptance, qualification, or release. A name does not establish its conditions or authority.
facts.finding_present: Whether an observed or suspected discrepancy is actually part of this request; false does not suppress an already known material counterexample.
facts.grant: Existing work/adoption/trial grant coordinate; no permission created by this string.
facts.operative_basis: The caller selected complete installed constitutional basis identity, matched to this selected native source target; descriptive coordinate, verified through its owning resolver.
facts.profile_executive: Whether the Product actually adopted the optional EXECUTIVE_BASELINE configuration for this work. False retains other adopted configuration law and does not waive required assessment.
facts.recurring_failure: Whether repeated failure, rising repair cost, or repeated insufficient review/context is observed for this subject; it does not itself establish a cause.
facts.repair_planned: Whether this request includes selecting, constructing or verifying a repair; this does not assert a reproduction, passing test, accepted diagnosis or repair authority.
facts.reuse_evidence: Whether the request proposes relying on previous evidence or a closed result. True requires checking applicability; it does not assert validity.
facts.review_in_scope: Whether the request includes planning or consuming an assessment of a declared exact subject; true does not assert independence, performance or satisfaction.
facts.sdlc_workflow: True only when the requested constraint decision concerns the declared work/QA/triage/repair/boundary/reuse workflow family, not arbitrary technical design or code correctness.
facts.source_changed: Whether a material source, basis, input, frame declaration or revising observation changed for this request. False must not conceal known drift.
facts.target_product: Exact owning Product Definition identity for the actual caller, not reusable corpus identity.
facts.task: Actual work/claim coordinate and bounded outcome; no admission created.
